resolution.note: tsconfig includes evals/; rule test test/rules/typecheck-coverage.test.ts fails on any tracked .ts outside the includes

title: Typecheck every tracked .ts file, including evals/
body:
Outcome: tsc covers every tracked .ts file, and a rule test fails when a tracked .ts file sits outside the tsconfig include.
Evidence: tsconfig.json:16 includes src, scripts and test only; evals/fr40/power.ts, evals/skill-selection/parse.ts and evals/skill-selection/run.ts are never typechecked and hold 7 errors (lane probe with the repository's tsc).
Source: finding LT3 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-lint-test.md (t3code typechecks every workspace, evals included).
Acceptance: `tsc --noEmit --listFilesOnly` lists the three evals files and `npm run check` exits 0; a seeded stray .ts file outside the includes fails the rule test.
